These five image views completed before the first transcription judgment or any score. The three poster views are the exact ordered packet files. No ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed. Native/view sizes were independently read from PNG IHDR. This is my semantic viewing/order attestation; no tool trace or runtime thread ID is invented. No image was generated or edited and no peer review was accessed.
